en: 1 Thessalonians 5

p.src: 1  But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

en: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
u.src: 1  But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

p.src: 2  For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

en: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
u.src: 2  For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

p.src: 3  For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

en: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.
u.src: 3  For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

p.src: 4  But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

en: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.
u.src: 4  But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

p.src: 5  You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

en: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,
u.src: 5  You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

p.src: 6  so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

en: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
u.src: 6  so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

p.src: 7  For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

en: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.
u.src: 7  For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

p.src: 8  But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

en: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
u.src: 8  But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

p.src: 9  For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

en: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
u.src: 9  For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

p.src: 10  who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

en: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
u.src: 10  who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

p.src: 11  Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

en: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
u.src: 11  Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

p.src: 12  But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

en: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
u.src: 12  But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

p.src: 13  and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

en: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
u.src: 13  and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

p.src: 14  We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

en: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
u.src: 14  We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

p.src: 15  See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

en: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
u.src: 15  See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

p.src: 16  Always rejoice.

en: Always rejoice.
u.src: 16  Always rejoice.

p.src: 17  Pray without ceasing.

en: Pray without ceasing.
u.src: 17  Pray without ceasing.

p.src: 18  In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

en: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
u.src: 18  In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

p.src: 19  Don’t quench the Spirit.

en: Don’t quench the Spirit.
u.src: 19  Don’t quench the Spirit.

p.src: 20  Don’t despise prophecies.

en: Don’t despise prophecies.
u.src: 20  Don’t despise prophecies.

p.src: 21  Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

en: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
u.src: 21  Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

p.src: 22  Abstain from every form of evil.

en: Abstain from every form of evil.
u.src: 22  Abstain from every form of evil.

p.src: 23  May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

en: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
u.src: 23  May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

p.src: 24  He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

en: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
u.src: 24  He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

p.src: 25  Brothers, pray for us.

en: Brothers, pray for us.
u.src: 25  Brothers, pray for us.

p.src: 26  Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

en: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
u.src: 26  Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

p.src: 27  I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

en: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.
u.src: 27  I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

p.src: 28  The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
u.src: 28  The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
